source_refs.note: Reactions of Amides: a main subheading of 24.5 Amides, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 127-129.

blocks.text: Amides saare acid derivatives mein sab se kam reactive hain, kyunke nitrogen ka lone pair carbonyl group ke oxygen par phaila hua hai, jis se carbonyl carbon ka +δ charge (electrophilic power) kam ho jata hai.
Amides ke reactions aam taur par slow (dheere) hote hain aur in ke liye der tak garam karna ya catalyst (acid ya base) chahiye. In mein se kuch yeh hain:
Jin amides ke nitrogen par koi group na ho (unsubstituted amides), woh acid ke saath carboxylic acid aur ammonium salt dete hain.

blocks.alt: CH3-C(=O)-NH2 + H2O + HCl se CH3-C(=O)-OH + NH4Cl.
blocks.caption: Ethanamide ki acid hydrolysis (kitab ke page 128 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: Base ki madad se (base-catalyzed) hydrolysis mein carboxylic acid ka salt aur ammonia bante hain. Is salt ko dilute hydrochloric acid se treat karne par free (azad) carboxylic acid milta hai.

blocks.alt: CH3-C(=O)-NH2 + NaOH se CH3-C(=O)-O-Na+ + NH3. Neeche: CH3-C(=O)-O-Na+ + HCl se CH3-C(=O)-OH + NaCl.
blocks.caption: Ethanamide ki base hydrolysis aur salt se acid (kitab ke page 129 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: Dry ethoxyethane (ether) mein lithium tetrahydridoaluminate(III), LiAlH₄, amides ko primary amines mein reduce kar deta hai.

blocks.alt: CH3-C(=O)-NH2 + 4[H], arrow ke oopar LiAlH4 aur neeche Dry ether, se CH3-CH2-NH2 + H2O. Neeche: benzamide (benzene ring-C(=O)-NH2) + 4[H] (LiAlH4, dry ether) se ring-CH2-NH2 + H2O.
blocks.caption: LiAlH4 se ethanamide aur benzamide ki reduction (kitab ke page 129 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: LiAlH₄ sirf C=O ko CH₂ mein badalta hai: ethanamide se ethanamine aur benzamide se phenylmethanamine (C₆H₅CH₂NH₂) banti hai. Benzene ring waisi hi rehti hai.

blocks.prompt: Amides amines se kaheen weak (kamzor) bases kyun hain?
blocks.explanation: Amide ke nitrogen ka lone pair carbonyl oxygen par delocalised hai, is liye proton lene ke liye nahi milta.

items: Acyl chloride + NH₃ ya primary amine (excess, room temperature) se amides.
Delocalised N lone pair: neutral solution, C–N 132 pm, sab se kam reactive acid derivative.
Hydrolysis (acid: RCOOH + NH₄Cl; base: RCOONa + NH₃); LiAlH₄ se reduction: primary amine.
